column1: # Follow-up to transport-aws-udp-batch.tsv: ergon-io UDP on smoltcp over
# DPDK (ping on the stack, pong on the kernel) beside Aeron on DPDK
# (md-dpdk, both ends) and ergon-io on the kernel, same loads and bursts.
# (The first session's smoltcp arm had no smoltcp-dpdk binary: the runner
# built one only for an F-Stack arm.)
# arm   name                 binary     setup    hosts  arguments
arm  eio-udp-smol        udp_lat    sockets  two  --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin
arm  eio-udp-smol-b8     udp_lat    sockets  two  --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin --burst 8
arm  eio-udp-b8          udp_lat    sockets  two  --impl ergon --burst 8
arm  dpdk-aeron-udp-b8   aeron_lat  dpdk     two  --mode udp --reliable false --burst 8
# set   pair par host loads                 streams  netem  arms
